full_judgment: 16. In the case of JatindraNathVs. ManindraNath and another, reported in A.I.R. 1950 Calcutta 330, the allegation was that of causing prostitution in public. The case was that in a premise a number of young women of immoral character and men of bad character came and disturbed the neighbourhood by singing obscene songs.
